The Good Report according to

Lukas

Introduction

The (one who) wrote this document was Lukas a disciple of Jesus (MS Hisus) long_ago. He was a healer/doctor whose language was Grigu and he told about the actions of the Lord Jesus. He also was a good friend of Paul (MS Pablu), and they accompanied_each_other in going to various places in_order for tell the word of God (MS Manama). From that, he also wrote a different document which was “The Acts”.

This document was_sent by Lukas to Tiyupilu who was said by some that he was a respected person from_Ruma (MS Ruma). His story begins there with the prophesying of the birth of John the Baptist (MS Huwan ne Talagbewutismu) and of the Lord Jesus and until Jesus was lifted_up. Lukas also told that Jesus was the Christ (MS Kristu) that was promised by God who would save the Hudiyus and all the non Hudiyus who believe in him.

The story about the mercy of Jesus to the people who were_taken_advantage_of and to sinners is also told here in this document, his healing of the sick(pl) and (those) entered by evil_spirits, his raising the dead(pl), and the his teaching. It repeatedly_returns here also concerning the Spirit of God, praying, forgiving sins, the woman helping in the work of Jesus, and preparing the believers for the returning of the Lord.

The standing of Jesus before Hirudis
